audit_findings: The app did not actually expose fewer than 100 verbs; it loaded 1077 verbs, but the conjugator intentionally displayed only a 25-verb starter list when the search box was empty.
UI copy overclaimed and felt noisy: "1000+ Verben wie ein echtes Nachschlagewerk", "Konjugator · dynamische Übung", and long subtitles were learner-irrelevant.
The learning paths used internal/category-style descriptions rather than compact learner labels.
The dynamic verb module name was technical and should not be visible to learners.
changes: Added clear verb-list metadata: starter count, available count, search result count.
Added an "Alle anzeigen" toggle so all 1077 verbs are visible without requiring search.
Removed or shortened redundant brand subtitles and helper copy.
Kept the grammar-first structure and v6 adverb/deklination modules.
